scope: Posthoc bounded10case TRAINING-only chess-context diagnosis; no654, no engine/browser/model fitting. SavedPV trajectories only, not new tactical proof.
selection: Fixed first optimizer final5fold OOF cost1; five highest-scored non-easy falseawards; five lowest-scored eligible missedpositives with bothmappedloss<=1 and finite aftercp>=0.

cases.diagnosis: Routine liquidation supported by saved best line: Rxc1+ Rxc1 Rxc1+ Rxc1 Qxd4. The rooks are exchanged and the knight on d4 supplies the delayed payout. Physical debt3=-100 already signals recovery; sequential trajectory/victim identity is not retained in75 scalars.

cases.diagnosis: Qh4 leaves bishopf4 available to Rxf4 after preceding Rf6; saved best defense is Qg8, declining it. This is a genuine-looking quiet attacking offer labeled Best, counterexample to automatically awarding new unmoved-piece offers.
cases.signal_classification: Counterexample: same broad quiet-offer signature as genuine misses; do not force label corruption or easy veto.

cases.diagnosis: Rxe4 trades a rook for bishop after dxe4; saved before top2 prefer Ra3/Ra4. Current mapped loss4.815 is just inside qualitygate5, while current Chess.com label is Inaccuracy. Raw physical sacrifice200 is real, so sacrifice semantics alone cannot settle quality-label disagreement.

cases.diagnosis: Bxf6 captures a knight while rook a1 is attacked after Nxb3. Best defense gxf6 exchanges the bishop, then saved line Nh4 Bg6 Qxb3 collects the other knight. Optional Nxa1 is inferior in saved secondPV, followed by Bxe7 and Bxd6+. A routine capture is conflated with an incidental offered rook.
cases.signal_classification: Physicaldebt3=-190 already available; opponentbest-root acceptance identity and separate victim-specific trajectory omitted.

cases.diagnosis: Rxd7+ is labeled Excellent. Saved prior and before best show mate4; played root has mate6 and after mate5. The move preserves an existing forced win and slows its shortest route. Mate values, rank2 and safealternative already exist in75features.
cases.signal_classification: Available mate-distance/prior-winning context underused, not an absent-feature finding.

cases.diagnosis: Quiet Kg2 keeps knightc7 capturable by Rxc7 after Kh7, but saved best defense is g5 and the tactical game continues. Board/material scalar has debt0 and ECfalse despite recorded Brilliant. No conditional acceptance PV saved; do not assert unproven mate/deflection mechanism.

cases.diagnosis: After dxe4 opens bishopf7 diagonal to rookb3, Nb4 moves the attacked knightd3 while leaving the exchange. Best line Bxb3 axb3 retains a genuine200 material deficit and evaluation+119cp. ECfalse contradicts a simple physical-investment interpretation.
cases.signal_classification: Sustained physical exchange investment present in features but ECfalse learned pattern suppresses it; bestacceptance/debt persistence omitted.

cases.diagnosis: Nh5 leaves knight h2 available to Rxh2 and renews an attack: saved best line d4 Ng3+ Kd3 Nxh1. Existing feature move_check=false misses the next-move checkingfork motif. No saved Rxh2 conditional PV, so cannot prove that acceptance is refuted by this exact fork.
cases.signal_classification: Omitted threatened next-move forcing action; movedpiece versus sacrificedpiece are different.

cases.diagnosis: Nxe5 captures a pawn while leaving rookb6 available to Nxb6 after Nd5. Saved best defense declines it (c5 or Qxa7), while alternative dxe5 before move also permits Nxb6 axb6. ECfalse despite physical investment110.
cases.signal_classification: Counterexample to requiring opponent bestroot to accept every genuine offer; acceptance desirability is a feature, not a blanketgate.

cases.diagnosis: cxd4 captures a pawn and leaves rookb3 on bishope6 diagonal. Best defense Bxb3 Qxb3 yields sustained net110 investment. Prior own position already allowed Bxb3, so blanket novelty would reject this recorded Brilliant.
cases.signal_classification: Available priorliability200 and physicaldebt110; newdecision contextual proof rather than novelty alone.

recommendation: Prioritize victim-specific offer context: whether current/prior best opponent roots actually accept the qualifying victim, and material deficit/payout trajectory along saved acceptance lines including cross-square recovery. Treat as additional causal features/diagnostic evidence, not a hardgate: Nxe5/Nh5/Kg2 are genuine offers declined by best defense. New engine evidence for unsaved acceptance branches would require separate authorization.
other_findings: Negative physicaldebt already marks two high-scored falseawards; model ignores some available signal.
Mate-distance/priorwinning and marginal quality already explain two more falseawards without a new feature.
Quiet-offer structural overlap remains: Qh4Best versus quiet realBrilliants. Ten cases cannot establish label corruption or a separator.
No rating/settings causality inferred; reviewer settings not consistently evidenced.
Cannot promise recognition gain without falseaward cost; do not launch another same-feature sweep from this diagnosis.
